title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Duo #10 (EthiopianCrossLattice+AmericanArtDeco+KlimtMosaic+KoreanNajeon / CzechBohemian+EscherTessellation+SpanishAndalusian+EgyptianMamluk)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Jamaican woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, sultry, soft pastel-peach hair styled in curly, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework, wide gold bands, dense lattice linework) dominates one zone. American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst, wide silver chrome bands, dense zigzag linework) dominates the second zone. Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders, wide gold bands, dense organic curved mosaic) dominates the third zone. Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands, dense dense scrollwork) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: leaning against a wall just out of frame.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale porcelain skin, deep smoky black eyeshadow blended far out beyond the eyes, a sharp black winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy black lips, sharply contoured cheekbones, a cold, poised expression, cool and composed, soft rose-gold hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes. Long square nails, chrome finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif (a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework, wide silver bands, dense engraved floral facets) dominates one zone. Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat, wide gold bands, dense morphing tessellation) dominates the second zone. Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns, wide silver bands, dense geometric star filigree) dominates the third zone. Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay, wide gold-and-silver bands, dense geometric star inlay) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: seated across two steps.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
